pages.text: The wood moves around an empty space. The amber inside becomes easier to see just before a strike.
pages.title: At the last marker
The bound guardian
pages.text: This charter names a particular guardian. Defeat that creature and then extract to settle the confrontation. Reaching the exit while it lives will not finish the work. A different creature killed elsewhere is not proof.

pages.title: Watch the ground
pages.text: Raised arms and an ember circle give warning of a sweep. Leave the marked ground before it lands. The exposed core is vulnerable during the windup, if you can attack and still get clear.

pages.title: Watch the ground
pages.text: As the core brightens, smaller warning marks can appear beneath its target. Keep moving out of them. Use the pause after a strike to regain space.
Read the raised arms. Leave the marked ground before it strikes.
